$comment: The Long Distillation. Optional by design — Rank X with no reset is a complete, finished game.
$masteryComment: Earned from lifetime renown at the moment you retire, so retiring later is worth more. Square root, so the first run is not worthless and the tenth is not absurd.
$townComment: A town's modifier reshapes which of the three gathering sites carries the run, so the Codex nodes you picked get tested differently each time.
$townComment2: Mossvale is the baseline: no modifiers at all, and where a new game opens. It is the town every other one is a deviation from, so it is also the honest 'no thanks' when branching out — and it is what makes a first run readable, since nothing in it is being quietly scaled.

towns.$comment: The only town nobody comes to. Owns the two penalties no other town had — footfall and contract payout — so the run has to be built on cheap stock and a wide cave rather than on trade.

Everything above ground, nothing below it. The counterpart to Hollowreach, and the only place where the cave is the weak leg. No negative caveTilesBonus: tile counts only ever grow (progression.ts widens the array and never shrinks it), so a minus there would be a field the engine silently ignores. The spread multiplier carries the penalty instead.
